correctness.rationale: Normalized spherical-harmonic cap integrals produce exact eigenvalue gap polynomials. The explicit rank-five rotation yields a real skew 3+2 block decomposition. Exact symbolic checks validate all block entries and the optimal two-block value 9/250. Oddness extends to signed cap thresholds; equality follows only from the two-block derivatives and angular bound.

value.rationale: The commutator is an exact, coordinate-free measure of incompatibility between two natural regional Slepian concentration operators. The first quadrupole band exhibits competing 3-dimensional and 2-dimensional angular sectors. Determining the sharp global interaction constant, the unique geometry of extremal caps, and excluding the other sector by an all-parameter certificate gives a nonroutine structural spectral invariant.
